title: Introduction to gganime
text: Start static plot. Add transition animate . transition_states() splits data discrete variable moves points resulting states. see animation gganimate print object call animate(). gganime call anime():
code: library(ggplot2) library(gganimate) #> No renderer backend detected. gganimate will default to writing frames to separate files #> Consider installing: #> - the `gifski` package for gif output #> - the `av` package for video output #> and restarting the R session library(gganime)  p <- ggplot(iris, aes(Petal.Width, Petal.Length)) +   geom_point() anim <- p +   transition_states(Species, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1) anime(anim, nframes = 30)

title: Introduction to gganime
text: gganime supports three gganimate’s transitions. transition_states(), , animates levels discrete variable. transition_time() animates along continuous variable, holding data range spacing frames matches spacing values. transition_reveal() keeps earlier data screen reveals rest along dimension, suits line growing time.
code: aq <- ggplot(airquality, aes(Day, Temp)) +   geom_point() +   transition_time(Month)  anime(aq, nframes = 30) #> Warning in FUN(X[[i]], ...): NAs introduced by coercion ec <- ggplot(economics, aes(date, unemploy)) +   geom_line() +   transition_reveal(date)  anime(ec, nframes = 40)

title: Introduction to gganime
text: transition exposes set per-frame variables. Insert title, subtitle, caption glue syntax, text swapped frame frame step geometry. transition provides different variables. transition_states() gives closest_state; transition_time() gives frame_time; transition_reveal() gives frame_along. three also provide frame, nframes, progress.
code: aq_labelled <- ggplot(airquality, aes(Day, Temp)) +   geom_point() +   transition_time(Month) +   labs(title = "Month: {frame_time}")  anime(aq_labelled, nframes = 30) #> Warning in FUN(X[[i]], ...): NAs introduced by coercion

title: Introduction to gganime
text: ease_aes() sets aesthetic moves values across transition. default linear; naming aesthetic gives easing. enter_*() exit_*() control data appears leaves drawn, entrance exit can animated.
code: anime(anim + ease_aes("cubic-in-out"), nframes = 30) anim_species <- ggplot(iris, aes(Petal.Width, Petal.Length)) +   geom_point(aes(colour = Species), size = 2) +   transition_states(Species, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1)  anime(anim_species + enter_fade() + exit_shrink(), nframes = 30)

title: Introduction to gganime
text: shadow_mark() keeps marks earlier frames screen behind current one, scatter builds advances.
code: aq_shadow <- ggplot(airquality, aes(Day, Temp)) +   geom_point() +   transition_time(Month) +   shadow_mark(colour = "grey70") +   labs(title = "Month: {frame_time}")  anime(aq_shadow, nframes = 30) #> Warning in FUN(X[[i]], ...): NAs introduced by coercion

title: Introduction to gganime
text: gganime fixes frame count playback speed call anime(), way gganimate animate(): nframes sets many frames animation sampled (default 100). fps sets playback speed frames per second (default 10), give duration seconds set speed total length. loop repeats animation: TRUE, FALSE, number iterations. controls shows hides play scrub bar. width height fix widget size pixels; leaving NULL lets fill container. precision rounds animated coordinates, trims file size.

title: Introduction to gganime
text: anime() returns htmlwidget, prints RStudio Viewer, knits R Markdown Quarto documents, saves standalone HTML file htmlwidgets::saveWidget(): Loading gganime also makes bare gganimate plot print anime() console, printing anim gives widget without explicit call. Set options(gganime.autoprint = FALSE) keep gganimate’s output. Shiny, pair renderGganime() server gganimeOutput() UI.

title: Introduction to gganime
text: Transitions: transition_states(), transition_time(), transition_reveal(). Geoms: points, lines paths, bars columns, areas ribbons. enter_*() exit_*(), ease_aes(), per-frame labels title, subtitle, caption. shadow_mark(). Anything else stops message naming alternative. Current limits include faceted plots (one panel renders), non-Cartesian coordinate systems, shadow_wake() shadow_trail(), view_*() view_static().

text: gganime renders ggplot2 plot written gganimate syntax animated SVG. output self-contained HTML widget powered Anime.js (animejs package), instead GIF video. animation single SVG timeline attributes: stays sharp size, since marks vectors rather raster fixed pixels; file holds one copy scene plus per-element keyframes, one image per frame; plays browser scrub bar, reader can pause step frames.

title: Animate ggplot2 Plots with Anime.js
text: Write plot exactly gganimate, call anime() instead animate(). transition_time() animates continuous variable, sizing country’s bubble population filling {frame_time} label years:  shadow_mark() leaves earlier frames behind current one:  anime() returns htmlwidget, prints RStudio Viewer, embeds R Markdown Quarto, saves htmlwidgets::saveWidget(). Loading gganime also makes bare gganimate plot print anime() console; set options(gganime.autoprint = FALSE) keep gganimate’s output. Shiny, use gganimeOutput() renderGganime().
code: library(ggplot2) library(gganimate) library(gapminder) library(gganime)  p <- ggplot(gapminder, aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, size = pop, colour = country)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +   scale_colour_manual(values = country_colors) +   scale_size(range = c(2, 12)) +   scale_x_log10() +   labs(title = "Year: {frame_time}", x = "GDP per capita", y = "life expectancy") +   transition_time(year) +   ease_aes("linear")  anime(p) p <- ggplot(airquality, aes(Day, Temp)) +   geom_point() +   transition_time(Month) +   shadow_mark(colour = "grey70") +   labs(title = "Month: {frame_time}")  anime(p)
